empty.text: To get started, import the images you want to process: FITS and XISF files, TIFF and PNG images or camera RAW formats. You can choose individual files or a session folder. StarLight reads the capture data written in the file headers, recognizes the framed object and prepares the automatic stretch.

comparisonBefore: Before: the image as it was when opened

clipping.label: Show clipped pixels
clipping.title: Show clipped pixels ({key} key). Blue marks points crushed to pure black: there the background and the dark areas, such as dust lanes, have lost all detail; lower the black point a little or raise the shadow protection. Magenta marks points with at least one color blown to pure white: burnt cores and stars, which lose their color too; raise the white point, use the highlight protection or lower the top of the curves. The colors are only for looking and never reach the export.
